welcome.title: Welcome to L2 DPS Calculator
welcome.content1: This tool helps you analyze your combat performance in Lineage II by parsing your combat logs and calculating detailed DPS statistics.
welcome.content2: Track your skills, critical hits, and compare different builds or rotations to optimize your damage output.

capture.title: Capture Combat Logs
capture.content1: In-game, use the command ///textcapture on to start recording your combat logs.
capture.content2: When finished, use ///textcapture off to stop.
capture.content3: Logs are saved in your Lineage2/system folder as CharacterName_L2_MM_DD_HH_MM.log

upload.title: Upload & Analyze
upload.content1: Upload your .log file by dragging and dropping it into the upload area, or use the file picker.
upload.content2: You can also paste the log content directly into the text area if you prefer.
upload.content3: Set your fight duration and click Calculate DPS to analyze.

results.title: View Your Results
results.content1: After calculation, you'll see your total DPS and a detailed breakdown of each skill used.
results.content2: Click on any skill name to expand and view individual damage lines. Stats include: Min, Max, Average, Hits, and Critical Hit rate.

save.title: Save & Compare
save.content1: Give your result a name and save it to build a collection of your DPS tests.
save.content2: Use the Compare button on skills to see side-by-side comparisons across different saved runs and track your progress.

ready.title: Ready to Begin?
ready.content1: You're all set! Start analyzing your combat performance and optimize your character's damage output.
ready.content2: Tip: You can reopen this guide anytime by clicking the ? button in the top right.

seo.title: L2 DPS Calculator
seo.description: Free Lineage 2 DPS Calculator - Parse combat logs, calculate Damage Per Second, analyze skills with min/max/average damage and critical hit rates. Supports 10 languages.
